bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$PWD/deploy/state/video-two-topic-20261123"
test -s "$stage/repair-two-video-topics.mjs"
set +e
docker exec -i deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs --input-type=module - < "$stage/repair-two-video-topics.mjs" > "$stage/dry-run.log" 2>&1
status=$?
set -e
if test "$status" -eq 0; then exit 0; fi
if test "$status" -ge 51 && test "$status" -le 59; then exit "$status"; fi
if grep -Eqi '(does not exist|relation .*does not exist|column .*does not exist)' "$stage/dry-run.log"; then exit 71; fi
if grep -Eqi '(ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND|Cannot find package|Cannot find module)' "$stage/dry-run.log"; then exit 72; fi
if grep -Eqi '(Token|401: Unauthorized|BOT_IDENTITY)' "$stage/dry-run.log"; then exit 73; fi
if grep -Eqi '(ENOTFOUND|ETIMEDOUT|ECONNREFUSED|EAI_AGAIN)' "$stage/dry-run.log"; then exit 74; fi
exit 79
